idPolicy: The identifier assigned at first triage is the identifier for life. Findings triaged in the Phase 9 registry keep their -P9- identifiers; findings first entering through Phase 10 operations take -EXT-. One namespace, no renumbering.
note: Zero findings. A finding exists only downstream of an ACCEPTED intake entry and advances only through the transitions declared in tools/candidate_ops.py. A finding is never closed because code changed: closure requires requalification evidence bound to the finding's artifact.
